stories.story_fr: Ameren vise une croissance de sa base tarifaire d'environ 10,6% par an de 2025 a 2030, adossee a 31,8 milliards de dollars d'investissements d'infrastructure planifies.
stories.story_en: Ameren targets rate base growth of about 10.6% annually from 2025 to 2030, underpinned by $31.8 billion of planned infrastructure investments.
stories.quote: Ameren's multi-year earnings growth is expected to be driven by $31.8 billion of infrastructure investments underpinning projected rate base growth of approximately 10.6% compounded annually from 2025 through 2030.

stories.story_fr: La direction emet une guidance de croissance du BPA de 6% a 8% par an sur 2026-2030, en prenant le point median 2026 de 5,35 dollars comme base.
stories.story_en: Management issues EPS growth guidance of 6% to 8% per year over 2026-2030, using the 2026 midpoint of $5.35 as the base.
stories.quote: Ameren expects EPS to grow at a 6% to 8% compound annual rate from 2026 through 2030, using the 2026 guidance range midpoint of $5.35 per share as the base.

stories.story_fr: Le segment Ameren Missouri a quasi double son resultat trimestriel a 76 millions de dollars au T1 2026 (contre 42 millions un an plus tot), porte par les nouveaux tarifs electriques et gaziers entres en vigueur a la mi-2025.
stories.story_en: The Ameren Missouri segment nearly doubled quarterly earnings to $76 million in Q1 2026 (from $42 million a year earlier), driven by new electric and gas service rates effective mid-2025.
stories.signal: Effet pleine periode des nouveaux tarifs
stories.quote: Ameren Missouri first quarter 2026 earnings were $76 million, compared to first quarter 2025 earnings of $42 million. The year-over-year increase reflected earnings on increased infrastructure investments, including infrastructure reflected in electric and natural gas service rates that became effective June 1, 2025, and September 1, 2025, respectively.

stories.story_fr: Le CEO souligne que la demande energetique augmente, justifiant un investissement d'infrastructure soutenu dans chacun des segments d'exploitation pour preparer la croissance future.
stories.story_en: The CEO highlights that energy demand is growing, justifying sustained infrastructure investment across each operating segment to prepare for future growth.
stories.signal: Demande en hausse et developpement economique
stories.quote: Customers depend on us every day for safe, reliable, and affordable energy and demand is growing, said Martin J. Lyons, Jr. Our strategic plan calls for prudent investments across each of our operating segments to optimize service for our customers and communities today while preparing for the future.

stories.story_fr: Le segment Ameren Transmission affiche un resultat record de 151 millions de dollars au T3 2025 (contre 90 millions un an plus tot), refletant la montee en puissance des investissements dans le reseau de transport regional MISO.
stories.story_en: The Ameren Transmission segment posted record earnings of $151 million in Q3 2025 (from $90 million a year earlier), reflecting ramping investments in the MISO regional transmission grid.
stories.quote: Ameren Transmission third quarter 2025 GAAP and adjusted earnings were $151 million and $103 million, respectively, compared to third quarter 2024 GAAP and adjusted earnings of $90 million and $100 million, respectively.
